description: This file contains unit tests for the statistics endpoints of a FastAPI web application. It tests throughput, buffer, and telemetry-related API endpoints, ensuring they respond correctly in different states.

classes.name: TestThroughputStats
classes.description: Test suite for /stats/throughput endpoint, including initial state and post-encapsulation tests.

classes.name: TestBufferStats
classes.description: Test suite for /stats/buffers endpoint, including initial state, after encapsulation, and after RX push tests.

classes.name: TestTelemetryStats
classes.description: Test suite for /stats/telemetry endpoint, including initial state and response structure tests.

methods.name: test_throughput_initial_state( self, test_client: TestClient, reset_global_service, )
methods.description: Verifies the initial throughput statistics (no traffic).

methods.name: test_throughput_after_encapsulation( self, test_client: TestClient, sample_ethernet_frame_1500b: str, reset_global_service, )
methods.description: Tests throughput stats after performing an encapsulation operation.

methods.name: test_buffers_initial_state( self, test_client: TestClient, reset_global_service, )
methods.description: Checks buffer stats when starting with no data.

methods.name: test_buffers_after_encapsulation( self, test_client: TestClient, sample_ethernet_frame_1500b: str, reset_global_service, )
methods.description: Checks buffer stats after encapsulating data, verifying TX queue population.

methods.name: test_buffers_after_rx_push( self, test_client: TestClient, sample_segment_set, reset_global_service, )
methods.description: Verifies buffer stats after pushing segments into RX.

methods.name: test_telemetry_initial_state( self, test_client: TestClient, reset_global_service, )
methods.description: Ensures telemetry counters are at initial state.

methods.name: test_telemetry_structure( self, test_client: TestClient, reset_global_service, )
methods.description: Validates the structure and types of telemetry response data.
